title: GitHub workflow: check a pull request from a fork with checkIssues.py --contribution
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG11.11.3 (maintainer 2026-10-25): a workflow .github/workflows/contribution.yml runs tools/checkIssues.py --contribution against the base branch for pull requests from forks, so a contribution that numbers or versions is refused before the review.
releaseNotes: A GitHub workflow, .github/workflows/contribution.yml, checks every pull request from a fork with tools/checkIssues.py --contribution against its base branch: a contribution that changes a numbered issue or a version file is refused.
